description: This file provides Ajax page updating capabilities in Drupal using jQuery $.ajax. It defines behaviors for attaching Ajax to form elements and links, handles Ajax errors, and manages Ajax requests and responses, including progress indicators and error handling.

classes.name: Drupal.Ajax
classes.description: Class representing an Ajax request in Drupal, managing request options, commands, and response handling.

classes.name: Drupal.AjaxError
classes.description: Class extending Error to handle Ajax request errors with detailed messages.

methods.name: Drupal.ajax
methods.description: Factory function to create and initialize a new Drupal.Ajax object, storing it in the instances array.

methods.name: Drupal.Ajax.prototype.execute
methods.description: Method to programmatically execute the Ajax request, returning a jqXHR object.

methods.name: Drupal.Ajax.prototype.eventResponse
methods.description: Handles events that trigger Ajax requests, preventing default actions and managing Ajax call execution.

methods.name: Drupal.Ajax.prototype.beforeSerialize
methods.description: Prepares form data before serialization, detaching behaviors and adding Ajax-specific data.

methods.name: Drupal.Ajax.prototype.beforeSubmit
methods.description: Placeholder for modifying form values before submission.

methods.name: Drupal.Ajax.prototype.beforeSend
methods.description: Prepares the XMLHttpRequest before sending, adding extra data and disabling the triggering element.

methods.name: Drupal.theme.ajaxProgressThrobber
methods.description: Returns HTML markup for an animated progress throbber with an optional message.
